name: au-bizdays
description: Business-day and deadline arithmetic for Australian states and territories, with per-state public holidays. A CLI and a read-only MCP server.
author: kd-011

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "for (const f of ['dist/cli.js', 'dist/mcp.js']) require('fs').chmodSync(f, 0o755)"
scripts.lint: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node scripts/check-text.mjs && node --check scripts/refresh-holidays.mjs && node --check scripts/lib/parse.mjs && node --check scripts/release.mjs && node --check scripts/render-demo.mjs
scripts.test:tz: npm run build && TZ=Australia/Perth node --test test/*.test.mjs && TZ=America/Los_Angeles node --test test/*.test.mjs
